name: Revision Log Default
description: Provides sensible defaults for revision logs, if none are given.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Summary 
 This module sets sane defaults for entity revision logs, which are used when no log is provided. This is useful if your content editors don't always fill out the revision log, which is fairly common as the revision log is not a required field (and humans are lazy).

 There are three variations of default revision logs provided by this module:

 
 When an entity is created, ex: "Created new Article" 
 When a new translation of an entity is created, ex: "Created French translation" 
 When fields are changed, ex: "Updated Title, Body, and Image fields" 
 
 Back to top 

 Set up 
 This module has no dependencies and no configuration, simply install it and start creating new revisions with empty revision log fields.

 Enjoy!
